svg.title: Binary Ninja: Level Design to Verified Native Assembly
svg.desc: Detailed process flowchart. Human and AI co-design an authored room and validate gameplay before freezing controller logic. A Windows agent compiles matching clean and OLLVM-BCF binaries and compares the outputs exhaustively with the game oracle. Linux verifies the evidence and builds runtime truth tables and authentic assembly displays. Gameplay feedback loops back to level design; logic changes require new native evidence.
